title: ImagePut
description: ImagePut represents the modifiable fields of a LXD image

auto_update.description: Whether the image should auto-update when a new build is available

expires_at.description:
When the image becomes obsolete

API extension: images_expiry

profiles.description:
List of profiles to use when creating from this image (if none provided by user)

API extension: image_profiles

public.description: Whether the image is available to unauthenticated users
